method: Before inspecting v1.3 scenarioAxes, independently authored axes for 18 cases using only id, commandKind, scenario, and expectedTermination. The timestamped review evidence is artifacts/d9-exit-contract.blind-axes.a2-v1.3.json. After freezing it, compared author axes, audited declared fields and vocabularies as sets, and read the ordered derivation for information flow rather than re-running the author's claimed checker.

resolves.A2-D9-V13-01: BLOCKER: analysis-required-coverage-missing says verdict=pass in the author axes; the blind model says indeterminate. Coverage short-circuiting makes both derive indeterminate, exposing the co-consistency trap.
resolves.A2-D9-V13-02: BLOCKER: baseline recipe incompatibility is encoded as requiredCoverageSatisfied=false. Baseline-format negotiation is not analysis Coverage and has a different remedy.
resolves.A2-D9-V13-03: BLOCKER: 38 of 39 scenarios are null, so reviewers cannot verify that axes describe the intended situation rather than merely reverse-engineering IDs.
resolves.A2-D9-V13-04: BLOCKER: the alleged closed wire contract is internally non-conforming: 38 expected terminations contain forbidden exitCode, two axes contain null, three used axes fields are undeclared, and emitted reason codes do not belong to reasonCodeVocabulary.
resolves.A2-D9-V13-05: BLOCKER: no executable D9 derivation/checker is retained in artifacts; referenceDerivation is English pseudocode. The claimed 39/39 execution is not independently reproducible from the binding object.
resolves.A2-D9-V13-06: BLOCKER: reason/error classification is not remedy-complete. Provider absence, unsupported language/relation, budget exhaustion, baseline incompatibility, snapshot convergence, and protocol fault require distinct actions and cannot be overloaded onto Coverage false.
resolves.A2-D9-V13-07: BLOCKER: finalizationCommitReached is syntactically an input, so the derivation is narrowly non-circular, but it is not a sufficient state-transition contract. It suppresses interruption and then re-derives instead of proving that an already-settled termination remains byte-identical.
resolves.A2-D9-V13-08: BLOCKER: required-delivery and optional-egress cases do not assert preservation of Run/verdict/durability or the exact delivery effect; repair verification does not assert receipt retention. expectedEffects is null for these load-bearing cases.

sealedPropertiesCovered.property: Every command maps to exactly one typed HostTermination and one boundary mapper derives process exit status.
Reason and error codes distinguish materially different remedies.
A signal after finalization cannot reclassify an already-settled termination.
The executable mapper and goldens must be retained as a checkable binding object.
Scenario semantics are checked with independently authored axes, not with the author's derivation.

materialMismatches.author: verdict=pass
materialMismatches.why39Of39MissesIt: requiredCoverageSatisfied=false takes precedence over verdict, so the same output class is obtained from a semantically false input.

materialMismatches.independent: required Coverage remains satisfied; comparison is unavailable because the fingerprint recipe is unsupported
materialMismatches.author: requiredCoverageSatisfied=false
materialMismatches.why39Of39MissesIt: both paths produce indeterminate, but only the independent model preserves the distinct upgrade/compatibility remedy.

materialMismatches.independent: coverage is unknown because a stable snapshot was not obtained
materialMismatches.author: requiredCoverageSatisfied=true
materialMismatches.disposition: cannot adjudicate from prose because scenario is null; v1.4 must state whether facts were derived before convergence exhaustion.

focusedAnswers.derivationNonCircular: PASS narrowly: finalizationCommitReached is an input, not an output. FAIL as a complete finalization proof because no settledTermination input is preserved across an interrupt event.
focusedAnswers.reasonVocabularyComplete: FAIL. It is neither closed in the goldens nor sufficiently separated by remedy.
focusedAnswers.absenceNotNullPolicy: APPROVE for the wire envelope because it prevents three-state ambiguity and maps cleanly to JSON omission. FAIL the candidate fixtures because they violate the policy.

requiredV1_4Shape: Real JSON Schema for scenario axes and HostTermination, with additionalProperties=false and no explicit null values.
A retained executable pure derivation plus a test that validates every input and output against the schemas.
One non-null falsifiable scenario sentence per golden, independently reviewable before axes.
One canonical reason/error vocabulary or an explicit pure mapping table, with remedy categories represented directly.
A finalization transition table whose input includes settledTermination, event, and expected unchanged termination, covering every termination class.
Effect assertions for optional and required delivery and repair receipt preservation.

confidence.blindSemanticFindings: high for two definite mismatches; medium for snapshot-invalidated because prose is absent
confidence.overall: high that D9 must remain CANDIDATE

whatWouldChangeMyMind: A v1.4 artifact that supplies schema-validated scenario prose and axes, retains an executable pure mapper, passes an independent axis review, and closes every listed contract contradiction without deriving semantics from expected classes.
knownLimitations: Only 18 of 39 cases received blind independent axes.
The review does not choose the final names of reason/error codes; it checks their remedy partition and closure.
No production implementation exists to test; this is a candidate-contract review.
